therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell growth inhibition through chromatin remodeling and gene expression changes
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with progressive or recurrent glioblastoma multiforme
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: proportion of patients alive and progression-free at 6 months

subgroup_findings: Stratum 2 (undergoing surgery): 26.7% PFS at 6 months (95% CI: 7.8-55.1%)
Stratum 3 (not undergoing surgery): 10% PFS at 6 months (95% CI: 1.2-31.7%)
Median overall survival: 5.7 months for Stratum 1, 10.2 months for Stratum 2, 2.2 months for Stratum 3
safety_signals: Gastrointestinal toxicity (abdominal pain, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting)
